# diagram-audience-fit

> Two agent skills (diagram-authoring, audience-fit), a zero-install Node renderer library (archdiag) and a stdlib-only Python gate (afgate) for verifiable architecture/audit diagrams with a gap report, plus reader-facing redraws that never change the findings. Built and run with Claude Code; any agent that reads files and runs commands can build it from the spec. Tested on Windows 11, Node 24.22, Python 3.12.

Start at AGENTS.md. Pin a release tag, not main. Code MIT, documentation CC BY 4.0.

## Entry points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): reading order, first command, install table into ~/.claude, adaptation rules, what not to adopt
- [docs/BUILD-SPEC.md](docs/BUILD-SPEC.md): the contract; §2 diagram workflow, §3 library contract, §4 audience-fit contract, §5 gate design, §7 acceptance A1-A16, §8 environment adaptation, §9 declared edits
- [docs/EVIDENCE.md](docs/EVIDENCE.md): what this release measured, origin records behind each rule, what is not claimed

## Run

- [verify/run_controls.py](verify/run_controls.py): `python -X utf8 verify/run_controls.py reference-impl <new-empty-dir>`; two-sided controls, every line must end in `-> ok`
- [verify/controls_run.txt](verify/controls_run.txt): reference transcript to compare sha256 values and counts against

- [reference-impl/skills/diagram-authoring/SKILL.md](reference-impl/skills/diagram-authoring/SKILL.md): diagram method

- [reference-impl/tools/audience-fit-gate/README.md](reference-impl/tools/audience-fit-gate/README.md): reader-edition gate
- [reference-impl/outputs/diagram-authoring/](reference-impl/outputs/diagram-authoring/): worked example pages with their build scripts

## Self-portrait (this repo drawn by its own method)

- [docs/self-portrait/refs.json](docs/self-portrait/refs.json): probe output, every file-to-file reference inside reference-impl/ with line numbers (from probe_refs.py)
- [docs/self-portrait/self-audit.html](docs/self-portrait/self-audit.html): engineering view with per-edge evidence, gap report, coverage declaration
- [docs/self-portrait/self-owner-view.html](docs/self-portrait/self-owner-view.html): reader view of the same model with its mapping table
